argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const username = ('{{ username }}' || '').replace(/^@/, ''); const limit = {{ limit }} || 10; const ct0 = document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim()).find(c=>c.startsWith('ct0='))?.split('=')[1]; if (!ct0) return { error: 'Not logged into x.com (no ct0 cookie)' }; await new Promise(r => { const start = Date.now(); const poll = () => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[src*="pbs.twimg.com/media"]'); if (imgs.length > 0) return r(); if (Date.now() - start > 8000) return r(); setTimeout(poll, 500); }; poll(); }); const scrolls = Math.min(5, Math.ceil(limit / 3)); for (let i = 0; i < scrolls; i++) { window.scrollBy(0, window.innerHeight); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const results = []; const seen = new Set(); const images = document.querySelectorAll('img[src*="pbs.twimg.com/media"]'); for (const img of images) { if (results.length >= limit) break; const src = (img.getAttribute('src') || '').replace(/&name=\w+/, '&name=large'); if (!src || seen.has(src)) continue; seen.add(src); results.push({ index: results.length + 1, type: 'image', url: src, size: '' }); } const videos = document.querySelectorAll('video[src]'); for (const vid of videos) { if (results.length >= limit) break; const src = vid.getAttribute('src'); if (!src || seen.has(src)) continue; seen.add(src); results.push({ index: results.length + 1, type: 'video', url: src, size: '' }); } return { results }; }
